comments.body: I was able to pull this quest off Portobelo without having Marracaibo discovered

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
In case you got stuck charting South Caribbean Sea because you need to discover something, this quest is repeatable even you already do the 2nd quest chain and the discovery location is just a bit south from Maracaibo that's located in South Caribbean Sea as well.

Alternative way if you hate waiting for hours just for the phenomenon there.
